messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High ephemeral disk usage on k8s-node-17 (region-us-west). Pressure=disk, threshold=85%. Several serve-runtime pods OOM/killed recently. Paging oncall.
alex (oncall): ack. I’m looking now. Which pods are impacted?
tess (eng-sre): seeing repeated KILL from kubelet: eviction for ephemeral storage. Model-cache pod on node-17 restarted 3x in last 2m. Logs show writebloat to /var/lib/modelcache/journal.
liam (eng-runtime): noticed runtime error in logs before crash: "cuda: can't allocate memory" but node disk almost full, so KV cache flush failing. Might be cascade: modelcache writes land on disk journal, then when disk full, process crashes and OOMs follow.
carla (customer-success): any customer-visible errors yet? A few customers reported increased 503 rate on hosted endpoints 10 minutes ago.
alex (oncall): marking P0 for now given customer 503s. Live mitigation plan: stop writes to node-17, drain non-critical pods, rotate logs, evict heavy writers.
tess (eng-sre): runbook step: identify top writers: ssh to node-17 and run: 
```
sudo du -sh /var/lib/modelcache/* | sort -hr | head -n 10
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=100M
df -h /var/lib
```
I already ran du: modelcache/journal = 138G; logs=12G; node root usage 93%.
mike (infra): I’m on node-17. Confirmed large journal file under /var/lib/modelcache/journal/txn.log. It's likely unrotated due to recent crash loop.
alex (oncall): action1: cordon node-17. action2: drain non-critical pods (modelcache can be restarted on other nodes). action3: increase logrotate frequency for modelcache to avoid immediate refill.
liam (eng-runtime): temporary mitigation: set runtime env var MODEL_CACHE_DISABLE_PERSISTENCE=1 on new replicas so they don't write large journals while we heal. We can do a canary deployment to avoid global hit.
tess (eng-sre): running: `kubectl cordon k8s-node-17` now.
incident-bot: k8s-node-17 cordoned by tess at 2061003050.
alex (oncall): draining lower-priority pods: `kubectl drain k8s-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — be careful: we will exclude the customer-facing routing plane.
tess (eng-sre): drain started. Some pods evicted, but modelcache pods are crashlooping and get rescheduled back to node-17 due to anti-affinity gaps.
liam (eng-runtime): launched canary for runtime with MODEL_CACHE_DISABLE_PERSISTENCE=1 in staging and then prod route for 10% traffic. If stable, we can flip more.
carla (customer-success): notifying customers on affected orgs with a short note: "We are investigating increased 503s; engineers are mitigating. Expect intermittent errors for next 30-60m." Posting to ~affected-customers now.
support-bot: Ticket created #INC-4823 and linked to thread. Notifying SLA team.
mike (infra): manually truncated txn.log to free space: `sudo truncate -s 0 /var/lib/modelcache/journal/txn.log` — freed ~120G. Node disk now at 46%.
tess (eng-sre): good. After truncate, restarted kubelet-managed modelcache pods to let them rehydrate on other nodes. Also applied taint to node-17 to prevent scheduling until cleanup: `kubectl taint nodes k8s-node-17 disk-pressure=true:NoSchedule`.
alex (oncall): monitoring metrics: 503 count down to baseline within 3m, CPU/CUDA errors reduced. Any sign of data loss or cache corruption?
liam (eng-runtime): cache journal truncation might have dropped in-flight writes; runtime has reloaded model shards from shared blobstore so no model integrity issues. We should run a quick eval on a few endpoints though.
carla (customer-success): will collect any error reports and alert if customers see anomalous inference outputs.
tess (eng-sre): actionable followups: 1) create a cron job to vacuum modelcache journals daily, 2) add disk-usage alert with faster threshold on /var/lib/modelcache, 3) add affinity rules to avoid heavy writers collocating, 4) bake MODEL_CACHE_DISABLE_PERSISTENCE for emergency toggles.
alex (oncall): handing off to tess for post-incident cleanup and RCA. I’ll update incident status and create a brief summary for ops channel. Good job team.
mike (infra): will schedule node-17 maintenance tomorrow to ensure journal writepath fixed and file permission checks in place.
support-bot: SLA/Customer impact note: ~12 orgs briefly experienced 5xx between 2061002980-2061003160; no data exfiltration. Incident severity P1 -> P2 after mitigation. Ticket #INC-4823 updated.
liam (eng-runtime): posting a short code snippet to add to ops: 
```
# emergency toggle for runtime
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-runtime MODEL_CACHE_DISABLE_PERSISTENCE=true --record
```
carla (customer-success): posting customer update: "Services restored; we will follow up with a full postmortem." :thumbsup:
alex (oncall): closing active pager. If anything resurfaces ping me directly. End of thread.
